verdict.rationale: Floot has a dedicated custom-domains doc page that says you can point your own domain at your Floot app so it is served from your own address instead of the *.floot.app subdomain. Combined with one-click publishing, this delivers the core of the story. missing for 10: details on DNS setup steps, SSL/HTTPS provisioning, plan requirements or limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect a custom domain to my published app

citations.quote: Point your own domain at your Floot app so it is served from your own address instead of its *.floot.app subdomain.
Just one click “publish” and you're live.
